scope_and_method.search_cap: Exactly one bounded catalog promo query and one online shop/marketplace query per country.
notes: Search results were discovery leads only. No snippet price, product offer, or discount was accepted as evidence.
No merchant, catalog, flyer, shop, product, or offer page was opened. Robots checks were the only direct page opens.
No second search was run for any country. All query strings are recorded exactly as sent.
The permitted reader returned Internal Error for 20 robots URLs; no retries or alternate access paths were used.
The single readable robots file was Carrefour Armenia; access rules were recorded, but terms/reuse and offer scope were not verified.
New merchant/catalog candidates remain audit-only and require Owner approval; none qualifies as a verified official catalog.

robots_checks.details: HTTP 200; public path rules disallow /catalog/, query URLs, checkout and private paths.
